description.p: dfiles is a fast, keyboard-centric, dual-pane Linux file manager built with GTK4, Libadwaita, and VTE.

ul.li: Dual-pane directory browsing with fast F3 toggle and focus cycling
Integrated terminal drawer (F4) with bidirectional directory synchronization
Live inspector sidebar (F11) with image previews and async checksum verification
Non-blocking asynchronous file operations with Freedesktop trash compliance

description.p: Initial release of dfiles featuring dual-pane browsing, embedded terminal drawer, and live inspector.
